name: Megaport Limited
summary: Megaport Limited provides on-demand data and network interconnection services in Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, India, Singapore, Japan, the United States of America, Canada, Mexico, and Brazil, and Europe. It operates a Software Defined Network platform that enables customers to connect their network to other services, as well as agile networking.
